tradingPermission.title: Trading permission
tradingPermission.desc: How the agent handles orders at your connected brokerages. Paper orders are not affected. What you tell the agent in a conversation can narrow this, but only this setting lets orders skip your approval.
tradingPermission.noTradingDesc: The agent doesn't start trades. If you ask it for a specific order, it still waits for your approval.
tradingPermission.approveEachDesc: Every live order and staged instruction waits for your approval before it is sent.
tradingPermission.planFirstDesc: The agent agrees a plan with you, then can place orders inside it without waiting for your approval on each one. Useful when it works while you're away.
tradingPermission.autonomousDesc: The agent trades on its own judgment toward what you've asked of it. It may place orders you aren't aware of or haven't approved.

agreement.title: Let orders go out without your approval?
agreement.planFirst: Live orders and staged instructions at your connected brokerages will no longer wait for your approval. The agent is told to agree a plan with you before trading, but nothing enforces that.
agreement.autonomous: The agent can trade on its own judgment toward what you have asked of it, until you tell it otherwise. It may place orders you are not aware of or have not approved.
agreement.common: Orders are real and can lose money. The agent can misread data, misunderstand an instruction, or act on information that is out of date. You are responsible for every order placed through your accounts, including ones you did not see before they were sent. You can go back to approving each order at any time in Settings, and every order is recorded on the <orders>Orders page</orders>.
agreement.checkbox: I understand that orders the agent places are my responsibility.
agreement.changed: This agreement has changed since the page loaded. Reload to read the current version.

preferencesDesc: You can also ask the agent to change these in any chat.
subagentsDefaultDesc: Let the agent hand work to subagents. Threads follow this unless you switch one the other way in its chat input.
ownContext: Use my preferences and memory in shared workspaces
ownContextDesc: On your own messages in a shared workspace, the agent follows your answer preferences and can read your memory. In a conversation shared with the workspace, its answers are visible to the workspace's members.
resetConfirmMsg: This will clear all your preferences: risk tolerance, investment style, agent settings, your default models and other model settings (custom models and providers, quick-access models, per-model settings), and your dashboard layout. Conversations keep the models they use. You can set everything up again anytime in Settings or via the agent. Are you sure?
completeProfileDesc: A few questions so the agent's research fits how you invest.

searchProviderDesc: Search engine the agent uses for web searches.
searchProviderUpgradeHint: Some search providers are available on higher plans.
searchDepthDesc: How thoroughly the agent searches the web. Deeper levels use more credits per search.
searchDepthUpgradeHint: Deeper search levels are available on higher plans.
compactionProfileDesc: When a conversation compacts. Leave on system default and each model gets its own: 500k for Claude and GPT, and what the context window affords for the rest.
nativeCompactionAnthropicDesc: Claude summarizes the conversation itself when it compacts, so it keeps its reasoning in the turns it keeps. Its summary is readable, and a model you switch to reads the same one.
nativeCompactionOpenAIDesc: OpenAI compacts the conversation into an encrypted summary that only OpenAI models can read, through the API or a ChatGPT login. The compaction card shows a plain record of the conversation instead. Switch the thread to another provider's model and it gets that record, not the summary, so it loses detail from earlier tool results.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Compact early. Safe for any model; summaries may feel more frequent.

extended.label: Extended
extended.description: Preserve more context. Good default for 400k-context models.

economy.label: Economy
economy.description: Stays under 272k, past which OpenAI bills a whole request at long-context rates.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.description: More room before a summary on 1M-context models.

expansive.label: Expansive
expansive.description: Half of a 1M window before a summary. Each call costs more as the thread grows.

maximal.label: Maximum
maximal.description: Most of a 1M window. Highest cost per call; for 1M-context models only.

modelTuning.effortDesc: How hard a model thinks before answering, where the model offers a choice.
modelTuning.guidanceDesc: How much instruction the agent carries into a turn. Concise trims the coaching and leaves the facts.
modelTuning.coldCompaction: Summarize long threads after a break
modelTuning.coldCompactionDesc: When you come back to a long conversation after a while, it is summarized before your next message, which costs less than processing all of it again.
modelTuning.compactionModelDesc: Used for compacting long conversation context.
modelTuning.subagentsLink: Each subagent's model and effort are set in <pane>Plugins → Subagents</pane>.

deploymentCredentials.errUnknownSetting: Request included a setting unavailable in this build. Reload the page and retry.
deploymentCredentials.errInvalidFormat: Input contains whitespace or non-printable characters. Clean it and retry.

deploymentCredentials.probeValid: Network reachable and official endpoint verified the client credentials.

deploymentCredentials.probeNetworkError: Could not reach the official endpoint. Check outbound network, proxy, or firewall rules.
deploymentCredentials.probeRateLimited: Endpoint reachable, but rate-limited. Try again shortly.
deploymentCredentials.probeVaultError: Primary admin Vault lookup failed. Check database or encryption key configuration.
deploymentCredentials.probeIncomplete: Provide all required credentials in this group before running a connectivity test.
deploymentCredentials.probeFormatInvalid: Credentials contain whitespace or invalid characters.
deploymentCredentials.probeInvalidCredentials: Endpoint reachable, but the official server rejected the client credentials.

deploymentCredentials.probeFeishuAppUnavailable: Endpoint reachable, but Feishu reported the app is unavailable (10014). Confirm the app is published and enabled.
deploymentCredentials.probeFeishuInvalidSecret: Endpoint reachable, but Feishu rejected the App Secret.
